AKTA SETEM 1949 -            |
PERINTAH Duri SETEM (PENGECUALIAN) (No. 36) 1997

Pia menjalankan kuasa yang dibcrikan oleh subseksyen 80(1) Akta
Setem 1949, Menteri membuat perintah yang berikut:

1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Duti Setem
(Pengecualian) (No. 36) 1997,

2. Surat cara pindah milik harta di No. Lot 650, GM 211 dan No.

Lot 688, MG.1, Mukim Kuala Perlis yang disempurnakan oleh Hock

Bean Bee Mill Limited memihak kepada Pemegang Amanah SRJK

a Choon Siew pada 14 September 1996 adalah dikecualikan daripada
uti setem.                            |

Dibuat 19 November 1997.
(Perb. (8.09) 248/39/7-251 Vol. 3; PN. (PU*) 159/XX.]
ANWAR IBRAHIM,
Menteri Kewangan
STAMP ACT 1949
Stamp Duty (Exemprion) (No. 36) ORDER 1997

In exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 80(1) of the Stamp
Act 1949, the Minister makes the following order:

1, This order may be cited as the Stamp Duty (Exemption)
(No. 36) Order 1997.

2. The instrument of transfer of propertics at Lot No. 650, GM 211
and Lot No. 688, MG 1, Mukim Kuala Perlis executed by Hock Bean
Bee Mill Limited in favour of the Trustees for the SRJK (C) Choon
Siew on 14 September 1996 is cxempted from stamp duty.

Made 19 November 1997,
[Perb. (8.09) 248/39/7-251 Vol. 3; PN. (PU?) 159/XX.]

ANWAR IBRAHIM,
Minister of Finance
